sources.topic: Include text insertion, default KL type, standalone directives, three nested files and prohibition of routine-local TYPE declarations

contract.sources: Explicit captured text mappings or selected directories/device mappings; no callbacks, native support/install or environment discovery
contract.resolution: Case-insensitive relative names with KL default, KH/INC extensions, including-directory before ordered roots; mapped devices and isolated root paths
contract.expansion: Declarations, routines, executable or full program text; repeated includes repeat, cycle-safe depth-three expansion with no token fusion
contract.provenance: Primary/expanded/text/raw-file hashes, resolved dependency fingerprint, expansion records, compact physical spans and enriched generated source maps
contract.diagnostics: Compiler/lexer errors remap to original file/line/column; runtime and other report lines retain expanded numbers with physical mapping available
contract.publication: Single-source output/report and linked-project state/trace aliases cannot replace resolved inputs; preflight both outputs before publishing either
contract.projects: Shared include provider, captured source files and exclusion of referenced top-level fragments from program entries

boundaries: No native search/install discovery, binary environments, macros, traversal or included symlink/junction following
No cross-directive continuation, source token fusion or routine-local TYPE extension
Workbench text validation has no include-root editor; use CLI/API configuration
Original runtime file names are supplied through report mapping rather than automatic runtime source access; no controller equivalence claim
